content:
Evidence from the datasheet: each **ORDERING INFORMATION** row is one SKU (CWDM center + standard vs **-E** temp). Shared specs apply to all SKUs: protocols/rates in the technical table, Tx band **1471–1611 nm (G.694.2)**, Rx **1260–1620 nm**, **<1.5 W** (**-Cxx**) vs **<1.8 W** (**-Cxx-E**). **SO-SFP-10GE-ZR-Cxx** / **-Cxx-E** are family placeholders with no channel in the ordering table, so they are not separate modes. No penalties were supplied. No amplified paths—only unamplified ZR SKUs.
